REED-FLOWER_OF_DRAGON.title: Flower of the Dragon
REED-FLOWER_OF_DRAGON.description: At the start of combat, all enemies have a [gold]Basic[/gold] Spark [gold]Attached[/gold] to them. The first time you attack each turn, [gold]Burn[/gold] the target {Reed_Burn:diff()}.
REED-TEAR_OF_DRAGON.title: Tear of the Dragon
REED-TEAR_OF_DRAGON.description: At the start of combat, all enemies have a [gold]Cinder[/gold] Spark [gold]Attached[/gold] to them. The first time you attack each turn, [gold]Burn[/gold] the target {Reed_Burn:diff()}.
REED-NAMELESS_POEM.title: Nameless Poem
REED-NAMELESS_POEM.description: [gold]Memory[/gold] retains the records from the final turn of the previous combat as turn 0. At the start of combat, [gold]Recall[/gold] an Attack or Skill from turn 0's Memory.
